hook: 差集 G 專場開在G滑梯口——名牌用中文，防止走失。
script: gabble/gadfly/gaffe/gambol 先登台，其餘 orphan 接龍。清倉晚會續攤：同字母檢票，義核才是身份證。

members.senseAnchor: rapid and indistinct speech; speak (about unimportant matters) rapidly and incessantly
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-快而不清: gabble walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-快而不清」出場：gabble 一上場梗就黏住——快而不清楚的說。

related.synonyms: jabber, jabbering, chatter, piffle, palaver, prate

members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-n. 惹: gadfly walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-n. 惹」出場：gadfly 一上場梗就黏住——n. 惹人討厭的人。

members.senseAnchor: a socially awkward or tactless act
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-失態；過: gaffe walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-失態；過」出場：gaffe 一上場梗就黏住——失態；過失。

members.senseAnchor: gay or light-hearted recreational activity for diversion or amusement; play boisterously
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-雀躍: gambol walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-雀躍」出場：gambol 一上場梗就黏住——雀躍。

related.synonyms: play, frolic, romp, caper, lark, rollick

members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-呆子: gander walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-呆子」出場：gander 一上場梗就黏住——呆子。

members.senseAnchor: tall and thin and having long slender limbs; tall and thin
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-收場的: gangly walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-收場的」出場：gangly 一上場梗就黏住——收場的。

members.senseAnchor: make false by mutilation or addition; as of a message or story
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-篡改: garble walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-篡改」出場：garble 一上場梗就黏住——篡改。

members.senseAnchor: of great mass; huge and bulky
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-巨大的: gargantuan walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-巨大的」出場：gargantuan 一上場梗就黏住——巨大的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-豔俗的: garish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-豔俗的」出場：garish 一上場梗就黏住——豔俗的。

related.synonyms: brassy, cheap, flash, flashy, gaudy, gimcrack

members.senseAnchor: a storehouse for threshed grain or animal feed; acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-穀倉；獲: garner walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-穀倉；獲」出場：garner 一上場梗就黏住——穀倉；獲得。

members.senseAnchor: something (such as parsley) added to a dish for flavor or decoration; any decoration added as a trimming or adornment
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-裝飾: garnish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-裝飾」出場：garnish 一上場梗就黏住——裝飾。

members.senseAnchor: the quality of being wordy and talkative
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-饒舌: garrulity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-饒舌」出場：garrulity 一上場梗就黏住——饒舌。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-缺乏社交: gauche walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-缺乏社交」出場：gauche 一上場梗就黏住——缺乏社交經驗的。

members.senseAnchor: (Britain) a celebratory reunion feast or entertainment held a college; tastelessly showy
members.speakLineEn: Cue the G席-俗麗的: gaudy walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「G席-俗麗的」出場：gaudy 一上場梗就黏住——俗麗的。

related.synonyms: brassy, cheap, flash, flashy, garish, gimcrack

pitfalls: 勿因同字母硬串錯誤字根
